name: Small bridge near Honan
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary:
A view of part of a beam bridge at Honan (opposite the 'factories' in Guangzhou), supported by a pier of stone blocks, with houses on each side and Tanka boats in the river.
The drawing is squared up for transfer to a watercolour or an oil painting.
